name: ai-research-scout
description: Current due-diligence scout for AI, robotics, semiconductor, and deep-tech entities. The manifest pins a small paid menu: Serper Scrape as the primary official-news/page scraper, StableEnrich Firecrawl Scrape as a fallback scraper, and AIsa stock snapshot for public tickers. Company-enrichment endpoints that showed charge-on-failure behavior are intentionally excluded. The agent selects only the steps needed for the entity and synthesizes recent activity, stock signal, missing-data notes, and receipts.

entity.description: Company, lab, or project name to scout. Used in labels and final synthesis.

url.description: Official newsroom, blog, press-release, or recent-activity URL to scrape. Required by Serper Scrape and Firecrawl.

ticker.description: Public equity ticker for the AIsa real-time stock snapshot. Leave empty and skip the stock step for private entities.

steps.label: primary recent activity scrape — Serper Scrape for ${entity}
fallback recent activity scrape — StableEnrich Firecrawl Scrape for ${entity}
public-market stock snapshot — AIsa prices snapshot for ${ticker}
